history.overview: The Ocean God Halls were the sacred inner chambers where the most powerful oceanic rites were performed.

timeline.name: Halls Constructed
timeline.description: Built as the inner sanctified chambers of the Ocean God’s worship.

timeline.name: Planar Water Conduits Activated
timeline.description: Elevated channels were used to channel oceanic planar energy.

timeline.name: Discord Corruption
timeline.description: Discord ruptures twisted water flows and corrupted the halls.

timeline.name: Muramite Assault
timeline.description: Muramite forces attempted to seize the halls for their planar power.
